## Overview

The AeroBook 14 pairs a 2.8K OLED panel with Intel's Core Ultra 7 processor in an aluminum chassis that weighs just 1.4 kg. All-day battery life, a quiet fan curve and a full-size HDMI port make it an easy pick for work and travel.

*   Intel Core Ultra 7 258V processor with built-in AI acceleration
*   14" 2.8K OLED display with 120Hz refresh rate
*   Up to 18 hours of battery life (video playback)
*   Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4

## Specifications

72 Wh

Weight

1.4 kg (3.09 lb)

Operating System

Windows 11 Home

### Gorgeous screen, light enough to forget it's in my bag

5 out of 5 stars · Posted 3 weeks ago by kmorales

Upgraded from a 2019 ultrabook that cost about $1,500 back then. This one is faster, lighter and the OLED is ridiculous. I went with the 16GB model and haven't missed the extra memory.

### Great, but get the 32GB if you run VMs

4 out of 5 stars · Posted 1 month ago by devops\_dan

Build quality is excellent. Swapping between Docker and a couple of browsers maxes out 16 GB quickly, so for my workload the $1,349.99 config would have been the smarter buy.
